title: DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026 - 36 Vacancies for Scientist C/D/E, Apply by June 19 at rac.gov.in
author: Ash K.
summary: DRDO Recruitment & Assessment Centre (RAC) released Scientist recruitment notification (Advt. No. 157) on May 30, 2026. 36 vacancies for Scientist C, D, and E under Lateral Recruitment Scheme. Eligibility: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc/MBBS with 3–11 years experience. Apply online at rac.gov.in from May 30 to June 19, 2026 (4:00 PM). Salary: ₹67,700–₹1,23,100/month (Level 11–13). Selection: screening + interview. 75% in interview mandatory.
body: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) through its Recruitment & Assessment Centre (RAC) has released Advt. No. 157 for 36 Scientist vacancies (Scientist C, Scientist D, and Scientist E) in the Defence Research & Development Service (DRDS) cadre under the Lateral Recruitment Scheme. Applications are open at rac.gov.in from May 30 to June 19, 2026 (4:00 PM). This is a permanent central government appointment - not contractual.

DetailInformation
Advertisement No.157 (Lateral Recruitment Scheme)
Total Vacancies36 (Scientist C, D, and E)
Application Start DateMay 30, 2026
Last Date to ApplyJune 19, 2026 at 4:00 PM
Apply Portalrac.gov.in
Application Fee (General/OBC/EWS Male)₹100
Application Fee (SC/ST/PwBD/Women)NIL - fully exempted
Age LimitUp to 35 years as on June 19, 2026
Appointment TypeRegular permanent basis (not contractual)
Scientist C - Pay Level 11₹67,700–₹2,08,700/month
Scientist D - Pay Level 12₹78,800–₹2,09,200/month
Scientist E - Pay Level 13₹1,23,100–₹2,15,900/month
Interview LocationRAC, Lucknow Road, Timarpur, Delhi - in person only
Minimum Interview Score75% marks mandatory for final selection

Eligibility - experience is mandatory: This is a lateral recruitment - not a fresh graduate drive. Scientist C (Level 11): First Division B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc/M.Pharmacy/MBBS/MD in relevant discipline + minimum 3 years post-qualification experience. Scientist D (Level 12): Same qualification + minimum 6 years experience. Scientist E (Level 13): Same qualification + minimum 11 years experience. Candidates must apply separately for each post they wish to be considered for, mentioning their order of preference. All 36 vacancies are Unreserved (UR) category.

Selection process: Administrative Screening (document shortlisting) → Technical Screening (expert panel review of credentials and research work) → Personal Interview at RAC Delhi. The interview is strictly in-person - a preliminary online interview may be conducted if required but the final interview is always in-person at RAC, Timarpur, Delhi. Candidates must secure at least 75% marks in the final interview to be eligible for selection - a uniquely high bar that ensures only top-quality scientists are appointed.

Career under DRDO - why it's prestigious: DRDO scientists work on India's defence research programs - missiles, electronics warfare, aeronautics, materials science, naval systems, combat vehicles, and more. Career progression is under the Flexible Complimenting Scheme (FCS) - promotion to the next scientist grade is delinked from vacancies, meaning you can be promoted based on your own performance without waiting for a post to open. Central government benefits include DA, HRA, LTC, medical facilities for the entire family, and pension.

Disciplines covered: Based on Advt. No. 157, disciplines include Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences, and others. The exact discipline-wise vacancy list is in the official notification PDF on rac.gov.in. Check the notification carefully - applying for a post outside your discipline leads to rejection. See our UPSC CSE guide for other prestigious central government career routes.

faqs.question: What is the last date for DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 157) is June 19, 2026 at 4:00 PM. Apply online at rac.gov.in only - no offline applications accepted.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in DRDO RAC Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: DRDO RAC Advt. No. 157 has 36 vacancies for Scientist C, Scientist D, and Scientist E posts in the Defence Research & Development Service (DRDS) cadre. All 36 posts are Unreserved (UR) category under the Lateral Recruitment Scheme.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for DRDO RAC Scientist 2026?
faqs.answer: Scientist C: First Division B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc/M.Pharmacy/MBBS/MD in relevant discipline + 3 years post-qualification experience. Scientist D: Same + 6 years experience. Scientist E: Same + 11 years experience. Age limit: up to 35 years as on June 19, 2026. This is a lateral recruitment - fresh graduates are not eligible.

faqs.question: What is the salary for DRDO Scientist 2026?
faqs.answer: Scientist C: Pay Level 11 - ₹67,700/month basic pay. Scientist D: Pay Level 12 - ₹78,800/month. Scientist E: Pay Level 13 - ₹1,23,100/month. All plus DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and other central government benefits.

faqs.question: Is DRDO Scientist appointment permanent or contractual?
faqs.answer: DRDO RAC Advt. No. 157 is for regular permanent appointment under the Defence Research & Development Service (DRDS) cadre - not contractual or temporary. Selected scientists are government employees with full pension and service benefits.

faqs.question: What is the minimum interview score required for DRDO RAC selection?
faqs.answer: Candidates must score a minimum of 75% marks in the final personal interview at RAC Delhi to be eligible for selection. This is a mandatory qualifying threshold - candidates scoring below 75% in the interview are not selected regardless of their technical screening performance.

callout.heading: Experienced Scientists Only - 3 to 11 Years Required
callout.content: DRDO RAC Advt. 157 is a lateral recruitment for working professionals - not fresh graduates. Scientist C needs 3 years, Scientist D needs 6 years, Scientist E needs 11 years of post-qualification experience. If you qualify, this is one of the most prestigious permanent central government science positions available. Apply at rac.gov.in by June 19.
